limitations: Does not count transients, handle unequal part sizes, or settle absolute historical priority. The complete Goles-Olivos (1980) article was inaccessible; independent audit not performed.
scientific_integrity: The count is proved for all labelled balanced complete multipartite graphs with r>=4 under synchronous strict open-neighbor majority and tie retention; the two computation programs are finite cross-checks, not an independent proof.
title: Parity-controlled fixed points and two-cycles in balanced multipartite majority dynamics
